## Description of file: {#description}

This is an R Markdown document that will be used to organize Seawolf cruises to identify cruises of interest. A cruise of interest would be a NJ Trawl with W winds (Philadelphia, Washington D.C./Baltimore) or a NY Trawl with SW winds (NYC or CT). To learn more about the Seawolf see: [RV Seawolf](https://you.stonybrook.edu/somas/about/facilities/researchvessels/rv-seawolf/).

## Tasks: {#tasks}

-   ID cruises of interest
-   HYSPLIT backtraj **AND** wind vector models
-   talk with Israel *regularly*
-   create an inventory with cruises
-   check and update research journal daily

## Cruises: {#table}

```{r load_cruises, echo= FALSE}
library(flextable)
library(magrittr)  
  data <-read.csv("/Users/reneechabot/Desktop/Seawolf/CRUISES.csv", check.names = F)
   ft <- flextable(data) %>%
    bold(part = "header") %>%
    bold(j=1, part = "body") %>%
    border_inner(part = "all") %>%
    border_outer(part = "all") %>%
    align(align = "center", part = "all")
  ft
```

**Note** Unless otherwise specified, time is in UTC.

The data for these cruises are saved in [Google Drive](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/19m8oNmr-iL5Ns86GKEzK-MDxqx-Lhgbv?usp=drive_link) under their corresponding names. Only people with access can open the link.

The Seawolf's live and archived tracks/location are mapped on [Garmin](https://share.garmin.com/SeawolfLocation) and [MarineTraffic](https://www.marinetraffic.com/en/ais/details/ships/shipid:443286/mmsi:367390740/imo:8853489/vessel:SEAWOLF).

## Baoshan Chen Correspondence: {#bao}
 
_"I appreciate your help in sharing the data for comparison purposes only. Below is a list of my cruise dates. Due to the boat/weather issues, we couldn't monitor the entire NYB in many cruises, so some cruise dates are short. The 1 Hz filtered data is good enough for comparison. We use Licor-7000 (infrared method) taking air pCO2 measurements for 2 minutes every 2-3 hours. We also use CO2 std gas to calibrate the detector every several hours due to its more considerable drift than Picarro. We also account for the time that air goes to the instrument using your approach."_

_"There is no hurry to share the data. Feel free to share when you have time..._ 

_**A combination of UTC time, longitude, latitude, and CO2 (either in ppm or uatm) will be very helpful.**"_
 
**Dates of interested:**

1. 2/1/22-2/7/22
2. 5/12/22 - 5/14/22
3. 7/26/22-7/30/22
4. 9/27/22-9/30/22
5. 5/14/2023-5/19/2023 
6. 10/2/2023 -10/5/2023 

**Cruise comparison**

- _cruise 1 and date 1 -> all dates align_
- cruise 7 and date 2 -> cruise 7 has one extra date at the end
- cruise 10 and date 3 -> cruise 10 has 5 extra dates in the beginning
- _cruise 13 and date 4 -> all dates align_
- cruise 20 and date 5 -> cruise 20 has 13 extra dates in the beginning 
- cruise 23 and date 6 -> cruise 23 has 12 extra dates in the beginning

**Sending data:**

- check each for data spikes -> need to manually clip out (first half of previous email)
- then run the function in IGOR

Kris already sent Cruise #1 to Baoshan, I will just need to send 10, 13, 20, & 23.
Cruise #10 is giving me some problems with the csv- fixed my issue!

**_Function Save_1hz_data_baoshan()_**  (AIRPORT DATA)

	//store GPS, MET, and Picarro data
	wave groundspeed,time_utc
	duplicate/o groundspeed,GPS_time_only
	GPS_time_only= numtype(groundspeed)==0 ? Time_UTC : nan
	wavestats/Q GPS_time_only
	variable startpt=V_minrowloc
	variable endpt=v_maxrowloc


	string all_possible_waves="time_UTC;latitude_deg;longitude_deg;CO2;CO2_dry;CO2_dry_cal;CO2_dry_cal_moving_day;CO2_dry_cal_moving_night;H2O"

	// string all_possible_waves="time_UTC;time_local;Latitude_deg;Longitude_deg;height_of_geoid_m;Altitude_m;groundspeed;track;" //GPS
	// all_possible_waves+="magnetic_variation;fix_quality;N_satellites;HDOP;water_temp_C;heading;pitch;roll;pressure;temperature;w_dir;w_spd;" //GPS - MET
	// all_possible_waves+="ALARM_STATUS;INST_STATUS;solenoid_valves;MPVPosition;OutletValve;CavityPressure;CavityTemp;WarmBoxTemp;" //Picarro
	// all_possible_waves+="EtalonTemp;DasTemp;mid_k;low_k;high_k;meas_k;CO2_dry_cal_all;CO2_dry_cal;CH4_dry_cal_all;CH4_dry_cal;CO2_dry_cal_all_OS;" //Picarro
	// all_possible_waves+="CO2_dry_cal_OS;CH4_dry_cal_all_OS;CH4_dry_cal_OS;CO2;CO2_dry;CH4;CH4_dry;Meas_H2O;H2O;CO;CO_dry;CO_dry_cal;CO_dry_cal_all" //Picarro
	wave cal_time

	string waves2save=""
	variable i, n=itemsinList(all_possible_waves)

	for(i=0;i<n;i+=1) //Loop through all_possible_waves and if the wave exists add it to waves2save
		if(exists(stringfromlist(i,all_possible_waves)))
			if(whichlistitem(stringfromlist(i,all_possible_waves),"mid_k;low_k;high_k;meas_k;CO2_dry_cal_all;CH4_dry_cal_all;Meas_H2O;")!=-1)
				if(numpnts(cal_time)>0)
					waves2save+=stringfromlist(i,all_possible_waves)+";"
				endif
				//only save these if there is cal data during the cruise
			else
				duplicate/o/R=(startpt,endpt) $stringfromlist(i,all_possible_waves), $stringfromlist(i,all_possible_waves)+"temp"
				waves2save+=stringfromlist(i,all_possible_waves)+"temp;"
			endif
		endif
	endfor

	wave groundspeed,time_utc
	duplicate groundspeed,GPS_time_only
	GPS_time_only= numtype(groundspeed)==0 ? Time_UTC : nan
	wavestats/Q GPS_time_only

	string filename=Secs2Date(V_min,-2)+"__"+Secs2Date(V_max,-2)+"_Seawolf_1hz.csv"

	Save/J/DLIM=","/B/M="\r\n"/W waves2save as filename

	NVAR gps_time_offset, local_time_offset, picarro_lag_s
	NVAR co2_slope, co2_offs, ch4_slope, ch4_offs
	NVAR/Z co2_slope_OS, co2_offs_OS, ch4_slope_OS, ch4_offs_OS
	SVAR script_version, CO2_scale, CH4_scale, CO2_scale_OS, CH4_scale_OS

	variable lgr_flag=0, o3_flag=0, OS_CO2_cal_flag=0, OS_CH4_cal_flag=0, grimm_flag=0

	if(NVAR_Exists(co2_slope_OS))
		OS_CO2_cal_flag=1  //we did calibrate CO2 on an old scale too
	endif
	if(NVAR_Exists(ch4_slope_OS))
		OS_CH4_cal_flag=1  //we did calibrate CH4 on an old scale too
	endif

	string co2_slope_str, co2_offs_str, ch4_slope_str, ch4_offs_str, co2_slope_OS_str, co2_offs_OS_str, ch4_slope_OS_str, ch4_offs_OS_str
	sprintf co2_slope_str, "%.6f", co2_slope
	sprintf co2_offs_str, "%.6f", co2_offs
	sprintf ch4_slope_str, "%.6f", ch4_slope
	sprintf ch4_offs_str, "%.6f", ch4_offs
	if(OS_CO2_cal_flag)
		sprintf co2_slope_OS_str, "%.6f", co2_slope_OS
		sprintf co2_offs_OS_str, "%.6f", co2_offs_OS
	endif
	if(OS_CH4_cal_flag)
		sprintf ch4_slope_OS_str, "%.6f", ch4_slope_OS
		sprintf ch4_offs_OS_str, "%.6f", ch4_offs_OS
	endif

	make/O/T/n=1000 metadata // make large text wave to put metadata in - will trim down later
	i=0 // index counter
	metadata[i]="IGOR processing script used: Seawolf_processing_v"+script_version+".ipf"; i+=1
	metadata[i]=""; i+=1
	metadata[i]="Corrections applied to data:"; i+=1
	metadata[i]="Local time offset (relative to UTC) = "+num2str(local_time_offset)+" hr"; i+=1
	metadata[i]="Picarro inlet lag time = "+num2str(picarro_lag_s)+" s"; i+=1
	metadata[i]=""; i+=1
	metadata[i]="Calibration coefficients with convention:    calibrated_data = (raw_data - offset)/slope"; i+=1
	metadata[i]="Picarro CO2 calibration scale = "+CO2_scale; i+=1
	metadata[i]="Picarro CH4 calibration scale = "+CH4_scale; i+=1
	metadata[i]="Picarro CO2 calibration slope = "+co2_slope_str; i+=1
	metadata[i]="Picarro CO2 calibration offset = "+co2_offs_str+" ppm"; i+=1
	metadata[i]="Picarro CH4 calibration slope = "+ch4_slope_str; i+=1
	metadata[i]="Picarro CH4 calibration offset = "+ch4_offs_str+" ppm"; i+=1
	if(OS_CO2_cal_flag)
		metadata[i]="Picarro original CO2 calibration scale (\"_OS\" data) = "+CO2_scale_OS; i+=1
		metadata[i]="Picarro original scale CO2 calibration slope = "+co2_slope_OS_str; i+=1
		metadata[i]="Picarro original scale CO2 calibration offset = "+co2_offs_OS_str+" ppm"; i+=1
	endif
	if(OS_CH4_cal_flag)
		metadata[i]="Picarro original CH4 calibration scale (\"_OS\" data) = "+CH4_scale_OS; i+=1
		metadata[i]="Picarro original scale CH4 calibration slope = "+ch4_slope_OS_str; i+=1
		metadata[i]="Picarro original scale CH4 calibration offset = "+ch4_offs_OS_str+" ppm"; i+=1
	endif
	metadata[i]=""; i+=1
	metadata[i]="Notes:"; i+=1

	SVAR/Z Picarro_lag_date,Picarro_cal_date
	if(Svar_exists(Picarro_lag_date))
		metadata[i]="Using breath test from "+Picarro_lag_date+" for lag adjustment"; i+=1
		metadata[i]=""; i+=1
	endif
	if(Svar_exists(Picarro_cal_date))
		metadata[i]="Using lab calibration from "+Picarro_cal_date+" for Picarro data"; i+=1
	endif

	deletepoints i, (1000-i), metadata

	wavestats/Q GPS_time_only
	killwaves GPS_time_only
	string meta_filename=Secs2Date(V_min,-2)+"__"+Secs2Date(V_max,-2)+"_Seawolf_metadata.txt"
	Save/G/M="\r\n" metadata as meta_filename

	DoAlert 0, "Add notes manually to the metadata file"

	killwaves/Z metadata 
	End
